facts.business: Kothari Industrial Corporation Limited operates across diversified business segments including fertilizers, footwear, drones & geospatial services, FMCG & vending, food services, facility management services, and publishing.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualifications include: (1) Government subsidy receivable of Rs. 80.77 lakhs outstanding over 8 years with no documentary evidence or provision; (2) Lack of balance confirmations for promoter balances (Rs. 1.80 cr), trade receivables (Rs. 33.49 cr), trade payables (Rs. 23.24 cr), vendor advances (Rs. 15.06 cr), customer advances (Rs. 3.99 cr), other loans payable (Rs. 52.88 cr), and related party balances (Rs. 1.44 cr out of Rs. 15.26 cr); (3) Unreconciled GST input credit (Rs. 10.41 cr), output liability (Rs. 10.55 cr), and payable debit balance (Rs. 1.41 cr) with GST portal/GSTR-2B; (4) Inventory valuation reports not available for Rs. 10.98 cr out of Rs. 17.02 cr total inventory, and no tracking of non-moving/slow-moving items; (5) Pending litigation over land repossession in Coonoor with uncertain liability; (6) TDS default of Rs. 7.12 lakhs per TRACES portal; (7) Unreconciled statutory deductions (PF Rs. 40.68 lakhs, ESI Rs. 9.38 lakhs, PT Rs. 30.03 lakhs) against salary payable of Rs. 2.56 cr.

key_risks: Government policy and regulatory changes affecting fertilizer subsidies and pricing
Fluctuations in raw material prices and foreign exchange volatility
Dependence on monsoon patterns and agricultural demand for fertilizer business
Supply chain disruptions and logistics cost variations
Labour availability and increasing competitive intensity across segments
Evolving consumer preferences and market dynamics
Pending litigation over land repossession in Coonoor
Unreconciled GST balances and statutory dues
Lack of balance confirmations for significant receivables, payables, and related party balances
Inventory valuation uncertainties and non-moving stock tracking gaps
facts.related_party_note: All transactions entered into with Related Parties during the financial year were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length pricing basis. The Company has adopted a Policy on Related Party Transactions approved by the Board, available on www.kotharis.in. Balance confirmations were not provided for Rs. 1.44 crores out of total related party balances of Rs. 15.26 crores.
